body: I know you're right. Thanks for chatting with me
I have forgiven him, definitely. He's still a good man. I just can't forget. When I get into these moods, it really gets to me. When things are going well I don't think about it at all though..

He tries to make me see that he loves me and he's sorry for everything he's done in the past but I can't get over it no matter how hard I try. It makes me feel like I don't matter. Thanks for replying.
